mapper.select: select group_id as LayerGroupId, layer_group_info.layer_Name as layerName, style_name as styleName, remote_url as remoteUrl, server_type as serverType, ogc_protocal as ogcProtocal, min_level as minLevel, max_level as maxlevel from layer_group_info, map_server_info where map_server_info.server_id = layer_group_info.group_id and map_server_info.layer_name = #{layerName} order by id
